newsitem.title: USA: Golden Star starts Brazilian core drilling.
newsitem.headline: Golden Star starts Brazilian core drilling.

text.p: Golden Star Resources Ltd said Thursday core drilling has started at the 25,000 hectare Andorinhas gold project in the eastern part of the State of Para, Brazil.

It said the Andorinhas project is subject to an option agreement between 100 percent owned Southern Star Resources and Companhia Vale do Rio Doce SA, Brazil's largest mining company, under which Southern Star is earning a 50 percent interest in the property.

Preliminary analysis of surface outcrops, existing CVRD drill core and the underground workings also suggest the possibility for multiple mineralized horizons within the 14 kilometer regional shear zone, Golden Star said.

A detailed airborne magnetic-EM-radiometric survey is in progress to assist with the definition of the structural and lithologic controls for mineralization. A ground geophysical survey will be used to follow up the results of the airborne work.
